value.rationale: The natural smallest perturbations of a rotation-generated word complex exhibit a sharp circle-to-two-sphere transition. All proper reversal subsets are classified by explicit cyclic gap statistics; already with two reversed starts, the same number of additional generators can produce different integral homotopy types (13 versus 17 two-spheres at n=6). The structural graph-intersection and primitive-winding mechanism motivates why exactly this invariant controls the topology; it is neither a routine parameter renaming nor a known table recomputation.
